clips.title: The story
paras: At Jordan Stilwell’s forge outside Ironforge, a Purified Kor Gem is needed for a weapon of the Light. First, the corrupted stone must be cleansed by elven magic.

A Corrupted Kor Gem is held by naga in Blackfathom Deeps beneath the coast of Ashenvale. A paladin takes it to Thundris Windweaver, a night elf in Auberdine. Thundris draws on arcane and natural arts to purge the stone’s aquatic and shadowy taint. The cleanse leaves a Purified Kor Gem, fit to channel holy power.

Jordan Stilwell, a human weaponsmith outside Ironforge, needs the gem to forge a masterwork weapon. He has long held designs for an arm worthy of the Silver Hand, but lacked the rare materials to make it. The Purified Kor Gem, Whitestone Oak Lumber, and rare ore provide the spiritual core for channeling a paladin’s righteous wrath.
